name: Find
author: spotty
help:
Search file names and contents. Type find followed by your query; an empty query browses files.

The preview pane shows images, PDF pages, Office documents, videos, audio details, text, archive contents and 3D models (STL, OBJ, PLY, OFF, glTF, 3MF and Blender thumbnails), and result rows show a thumbnail of them. Settings → Triggers → Find → Previews switches thumbnails and each file type on or off.
